### Harvard in Tech is at an important turning point

We are a volunteer-led alumni community that has grown into a global network of founders, technologists, operators, investors, and professionals.
momentumSections.title: Why Support Harvard in Tech?

description: The find-your-place search in use, which a resting capture cannot show: one supporter's node lit gold and the rest of the network dimmed around it. This scenario used to demonstrate the donor wall's tier chips; the network replaced the wall, and the chips with it, so it was renamed and re-pointed at the affordance that now does the same job — letting a visitor find themselves in a page full of other people. Searching on a school rather than a name is deliberate: the network deliberately has no name lookup, because an anonymous supporter must not be confirmable by typing one.
